title: i18n: a master-detail field's `inlineTitle` has no translation slot — the inline child grids on a zh-CN create form read "Versions / Deviations / Payment Plan"
body:
Filing class: ① product defect (i18n surface) — reach: public door, measured in a browser on 18.1.0 with objectstack-ai/hotclm `main` (`pnpm demo:zh`, Console in zh-CN). **Reader:** the spec/i18n lane (`FieldTranslationSchema`, the i18n gate's field reach) and the objectui consumer (`attachInlineSubforms`).

## Symptom
On hotclm, every label of the `clm_contract` create form is Chinese except the six inline child-grid headings, which print the authored `inlineTitle` verbatim: **Versions · Deviations · Obligations · Payment Plan · Reviews · Signatures** (declared e.g. `src/objects/contract-version.object.ts:51` `inlineTitle: 'Versions'`). The app's `lint:i18n-gate` reports 0 missing keys, because there is no key to miss.

## Why
- `FieldTranslationSchema` (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts:119`) carries `label`, `help`, `placeholder`, `options` — no `inlineTitle`.
- objectui `packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx` `attachInlineSubforms` copies `d.inlineTitle` into the subform's `title` as is.
So an app has no place to put the translation, and the coverage gate cannot see the surface.

## Expected
A translation slot for `inlineTitle` (on the field translation, or the subform title resolved from the child object's translated plural label when `inlineTitle` is absent or untranslated), counted by the i18n coverage gate, and resolved before objectui renders it.

Dedupe: objectstack and objectui issues, 2,000 most recently updated each, all states, grepped for `inlineTitle` and `inline (grid) title` — 0 hits.

---
_Filed from the hotclm browser regression pass (2026-10-26)._
